raster_review.scope: independent editorial species-specific raster review; original source and 64px thumbnails; not botanical certification

anatomy.description: Falso frutto intero schematico di fragolina. Acheni sulla superficie esterna del ricettacolo rosso, calice e peduncolo verdi. Nessuna sezione o semi interni.

parts.label: Acheni esterni raffigurati
parts.meaning: Superfici e contorni visibili dei piccoli frutti esterni; il conteggio dei segni non è un dato biologico quantitativo.

parts.label: Peduncolo
parts.meaning: Peduncolo verde curvo già raffigurato nel raster.

parts.label: Calice
parts.meaning: Parti verdi del calice osservabili, senza ricostruire il tessuto coperto.
parts.source_path_selection_note: All explicitly inspected green paints belong to the calyx/peduncle in this raster. Add their actual geometry to recover narrow green tips missed by the hand polygon; earlier peduncle region retains priority.

parts.label: Ricettacolo esterno
parts.meaning: Superficie rossa del falso frutto e riflessi grafici. Le cavità lasciate dagli acheni nascosti sono di ispezione, non anatomia nuova.

anatomy.annotation_method: Manual botanical regions and source-pixel detail boundaries; detail candidates checked on overlay, no automatic anatomy recognition.
limitations: No hidden tissue reconstruction. Hiding parts may leave transparent gaps.
Tint changes are technical inspection only, not approved biological variants.
Illustrative detail marks are not quantitative organ counts.

optimization.method: Retrace same approved raster RGB input with lower trace color precision, then serialize boolean-intersection coordinates to 0.01 source pixel. No redraw or invented anatomy.

author: Fronda/Fungaroli
geometry: Source paint stacks intersected into actual anatomical part geometries; no raster, masks, clips or complete-object copies. Graphic underpaint retained inside each part to preserve antialiasing, not reconstructed hidden tissue.
unsupported: quantitative organ counts from illustrative marks
optimization_rejection_reason: Less aggressive retrace retains broad colors but changes shadows/highlights and increases raster RGB error; not selected because a conservative alternative preserves the original paint attributes.
